name: Misaki Kana
source:
A married woman with a neat and quiet personality. She is an ideal good wife who is family oriented and often stands up to her husband. She is devoted to her husband, but has never experienced sexual climax. She has a hidden masochistic nature that her kind husband and herself do not know about.
